review.intent_summary: Expose finalized sub-day changes alongside completed 24-hour aggregates and separately report unfinished-day progress.

criteria.criterion: Callers can select sum, mean, or last aggregation for completed and partial periods.
criteria.notes: Schema 1.0 supports all three; schema 1.1 makes the completed-day view unavailable for mean and last.

criteria.criterion: Regular timestamped sub-day samples produce distinct native and completed-period analysis views.
A trailing partial aggregate reports observed progress and links its native evidence while remaining outside the completed-period series.
criteria.notes: Schema 1.0 provides the linked marker. Schema 1.1 reports observed_sum and source indexes, but lacks native evidence references and retains an incomplete null slot in the daily grid.

criteria.criterion: An explicitly unfinished source sample is excluded from both analysis views.
A source cadence that does not evenly divide 24 hours is rejected.
criteria.notes: Schema 1.0 rejects it. Schema 1.1 accepts the request, analyzes native samples, and reports the daily view unavailable.

verification_evidence: Manual Python assertions: schema 1.0 returned two completed days, observed partial aggregate 12, and 12 references resolving to intraday evidence.

Manual Python assertions: schema 1.1 reported partial observed_sum 12 with aggregate_value null; mean and last returned explicit daily-view restrictions; a 5h request returned native analysis rather than rejection.
Manual Python assertions: a schema 1.1 unfinished source value contributed neither native evidence nor usable daily children.
remaining_gaps: Implement mean/last in schema 1.1 or explicitly scope criterion 1 to schema 1.0.
Provide schema 1.1 partial-marker evidence links or explicitly document its source-index and incomplete-grid representation as an accepted alternative.
Reject non-dividing schema 1.1 cadences or revise criterion 5 to permit daily-view unavailability.
